bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import base64, textwrap, json
script = r'''
import sys
import math
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

counts_path, meta_path, annot_path = sys.argv[1:4]

annot = pd.read_csv(annot_path, dtype=str)
required_annot = {\"sample\", \"celltype\"}
missing = required_annot.difference(annot.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f\"Sample annotation missing columns: {sorted(missing)}\")
cd14_samples = annot.loc[annot[\"celltype\"].astype(str).str.upper() == \"CD14\", \"sample\"].astype(str).tolist()
if not cd14_samples:
    raise ValueError(\"No CD14 samples found in sample annotation\")

counts = pd.read_csv(counts_path, index_col=0)
counts.index = counts.index.astype(str)
missing_cd14 = [s for s in cd14_samples if s not in counts.columns]
if missing_cd14:
    raise ValueError(f\"CD14 samples missing from counts: {missing_cd14[:10]} (n={len(missing_cd14)})\")
cd14 = counts.loc[:, cd14_samples].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors=\"raise\")

meta = pd.read_csv(meta_path, index_col=0, dtype={\"gene_biotype\": str})
meta.index = meta.index.astype(str)
required_meta = {\"Length\", \"gene_biotype\"}
missing = required_meta.difference(meta.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f\"Gene metadata missing columns: {sorted(missing)}\")
meta[\"Length\"] = pd.to_numeric(meta[\"Length\"], errors=\"raise\")

# Preserve count rows as the analysis unit and attach metadata by gene row label.
df = pd.DataFrame(index=cd14.index)
df[\"total_cd14_counts\"] = cd14.sum(axis=1)
df[\"mean_cd14_expression\"] = cd14.mean(axis=1)
df = df.join(meta[[\"Length\", \"gene_biotype\"]], how=\"inner\")

selected = df[(df[\"gene_biotype\"] == \"protein_coding\") & (df[\"total_cd14_counts\"] >= 10)].copy()
selected = selected.dropna(subset=[\"Length\", \"mean_cd14_expression\"])
if len(selected) < 2:
    raise ValueError(f\"Fewer than two selected genes: {len(selected)}\")

r = selected[\"Length\"].corr(selected[\"mean_cd14_expression\"], method=\"pearson\")
if pd.isna(r):
    raise ValueError(\"Pearson correlation is NA\")

with open(\"answer.tsv\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as out:
    out.write(\"metric\\tvalue\\n\")
    out.write(f\"pearson_r\\t{r:.17g}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_cd14_samples\\t{len(cd14_samples)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_counts_genes\\t{len(cd14)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_joined_genes\\t{len(df)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"n_selected_genes\\t{len(selected)}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"min_total_cd14_counts_selected\\t{selected['total_cd14_counts'].min():.17g}\\n\")
    out.write(f\"max_total_cd14_counts_selected\\t{selected['total_cd14_counts'].max():.17g}\\n\")
'''.strip() + '\\n'
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
